title: POST /plan request body (display/headset -> planner service). The reply is a route.json.

start.description: [x, y] in local metres: x east of the NW corner, y north (negative going south)

end.description: [x, y] in local metres, same frame as start

stops.description: Stop ids from stops.csv to visit (planner chooses the order). Empty list = direct route

use_hazard.description: Include the AI hazard term in the cost
